actor_metadata.authoring_description: GNU-ton the scholar: a small man in a coat and a wig, with a quill and a book. A parody of Isaac Newton. In his boss fight he rides the giant gnu and conducts its fists; on its back, and on a platform-fighter stage, he fights on his own feet.
actor_metadata.gameplay_description: The quill is long and fast and does little; the book is short and slow and ends a fight. As a boss he conducts from the saddle and fights a player who climbs to him.
